profile.headline: Email Marketing Specialist
profile.summary:
I have around 5+ years of sales and marketing experience. I've specialized in email marketing for about 2 years and counting.

I thrive in a position that enables me to analyze data and collaborate with colleagues to enhance processes. With my core skills being HTML, CSS, Klayvio, UI/UX design, WordPress, and Shopify, I know I can make a big impact.

Fun Fact: You can find me in the gym skipping rope for 20 minutes minimum or heating up the dance floor with some salsa moves. 

Let's connect and make magic happen!

positions.title: Email Developer and Web Developer
positions.description:
- Design email templates, landing pages, and static or dynamic websites then present designs to clients

- Develop the designs into code using HTML, CSS, and Javascript and utilize frameworks to decrease development time

- Running code through multiple QA unit tests to ensure it is following standard web protocols and emails are rendering through all email clients

- Implement code into the client's current website and/or ESP

positions.title: Email Developer
positions.description:
Demonstrate development skills to execute compelling email campaigns.
• Knowledge of design and development software:
• Photoshop, Illustrator, Dreamweaver
• Knowledge of automation/ESP platforms:
• SendGrid, Delivra, Site Impact
• Knowledge of testing tools:
• Email on Acid, Litmus
• Responsible for coding email projects and products following guidelines and templates provided.
• Versed in email design principles and best practices (including responsive design), A/B testing -
including a focus on accessibility, cross-device behavior, and troubleshooting compatibility issues.
• Collaborate successfully with creative designers and copywriters.
• Continuously learning about new trends, best practices, and technologies.

positions.title: Inside Sales Representative
positions.description:
Have successfully booked 100+ meetings, for Account Executives, since May start date. Exceeding Customer Facing Time KPIs of 60% vs a goal of 50%
Influenced $15k+ worth of sales

positions.title: Mobile Expert
positions.description:
-Assisted customers in new account setup and migration from the previous company platform to T-Mobile’s platform.
- Establishing and maintaining long-term relationships with clients
 - Build teams and provide strategic recommendations for improvement 
- Analyze customers' experience, advise on marketing strategy, retain retail clients, minimize churn - Creative problem solver able to identify obstacles and viable solutions
 - Coach new hires on best practices for systems and processes
- Keep a pulse on customers that have recently visited the store with weekly retention calls to minimize churn.
- Upsell & cross-sell opportunities in relation with Account Executives and Support teams to maintain and increase account revenue.

 Notable achievements: 100% Client satisfaction and 100% Growth.
positions.insights: Skills: Escalation Resolution · Cross-Selling · Customer Relationship Management (CRM) · Training · Troubleshooting · Microsoft Word · Organization Skills · Customer Support · Leadership · Customer Retention · Written Communication · Teamwork

positions.title: Sales Development Specialist
positions.description:
- Set up and successfully worked with Financial Advisors (FA) to help them reach their marketing objectives. 
- Initiated business development from acquisition to pitching, prepared strategic marketing proposals and pre-campaign research.  
 - End-to-end project management of multi-channel campaigns: including strong relationships with FAs, new concept creation, creative marketing input, briefing, time management, project delivery, overseeing partnerships and marketing campaigns
- Performance measurement focused on ROI: successfully generated 50k in revenue in 1 quarter, also contributed to bringing a product to market.
 
Notable achievements:  Customer acquisition and relationship, Generated 50k in revenue, Collaborated to bring a product to market
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft Office · Business Development · Microsoft Excel · Microsoft PowerPoint · Customer Relationship Management (CRM) · Strategic Thinking · HubSpot · Microsoft Word · Organization Skills · Customer Experience · Written Communication · Project Management · Teamwork · Negotiation · Product Development

positions.title: Order Picker / Warehouse Associate
positions.locationName: Martinsburg, West Virginia, United States · On-site
positions.description:
•Picked and fulfilled customer orders accurately in a high-volume distribution center environment using
an RF scanner.
•Maintained order accuracy and met daily productivity quotas while working overnight shifts in a
fast-paced fulfillment operation.
•Prepared, packed, and palletized outbound shipments, ensuring cargo was secure, correctly labeled,
and ready for transport.
•Followed all warehouse safety protocols and standard operating procedures to maintain a safe and
efficient work environment.
•Collaborated with team members and supervisors to ensure smooth workflow and on-time order
fulfillment.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
I worked with creatives to develop marketing skills to promote their business.

Identified pain points to develop an offer and created content that resonated with target markets, increasing customer engagement.

Constructed email campaigns, building a list of active readers from 0 to 100+.

Built and maintained Ad copy, Ad creatives, and written content, effectively reducing CPL rates by 30%.
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft Office · Microsoft Excel · Microsoft PowerPoint · Email Marketing · Copywriting · Microsoft Word · Organization Skills · Community Leadership · Written Communication · Project Management · Business-to-Business (B2B)

positions.title: Car Photographer
positions.description:
Photographed new and used vehicles for car dealerships.

Maintained client rapport and established quality customer experience.

Partnered with managers to prioritize certain vehicles.  

Retained all accounts after 1 dealership nearly canceled service.
positions.insights: Skills: Relationship Building · Time Management · Photography · Customer Service

positions.title: Sales Associate
positions.description:
Maintained current knowledge of store promotions, products, and customer service policies to serve customers better, resulting in returning customers. 

Helped customers complete purchases by explaining the benefits of becoming a credit card holder, thus increasing profits.

Organized racks and shelves to sustain the store's visual appearance, engage customers, and promote specific products, enhancing client relationships.
positions.insights: Skills: Creative Problem Solving · Conflict Resolution · Customer-focused Service · Customer Escalation Management
